buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque.

d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) PROCUREMENT OF CHEESE CUBE & CHEESE SLICE – 200 G PACK FOR OFFICERS' RATION 1. SCHEDULE OF REQUIREMENT No. of Pack Ser Item Pack Size Required Qty Total Qty s 1 Cheese Cube200 g 30 Kg 150 Packs 30 Kg 2 Cheese Slice 200 g 30 Kg 150 Packs 30 Kg Total 60 Kg 300 Packs 60 Kg Quantity in words: Sixty Kilograms only. Calculation: Cheese Cube: 150 × 200 g = 30 Kg Cheese Slice: 150 × 200 g = 30 Kg Total: 300 × 200 g = 60 Kg The supplier shall supply 150 sealed retail packs of 200 g each for Cheese Cube and 150 sealed re tail packs of 200 g each for Cheese Slice. 2. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION A. CHEESE CUBE (a) Product shall be Cheese / Processed Cheese, suitable for human consumption and conforming to the latest applicable FSSAI standards/regulations. (b) Each retail pack shall contain 200 g net quantity. (c) Product shall have characteristic colour, taste, flavour, odour and texture. (d) Cheese shall be firm, uniform and free from visible mould, foreign matter, rancidity, abnormal odour an d contamination.

(e) Product shall be wholesome, hygienic and fit for human consumption. B. CHEESE SLICE (a) Product shall be Cheese Slices / Processed Cheese Slices, suitable for human consumption and con forming to the latest applicable FSSAI standards/regulations. (b) Each retail pack shall contain 200 g net quantity. (c) Slices shall be uniform, properly formed, clean and readily separable, as applicable to the product. (d) Product shall have characteristic taste, flavour, colour and texture. (e) Product shall be free from mould, rancidity, foreign matter, abnormal odour and contamination. (f) Product shall be wholesome, hygienic and fit for human consumption. 3. FSSAI & STATUTORY REQUIREMENTS (a) Manufacturer/Supplier shall possess a valid FSSAI Licence/Registration applicable to the offered pro duct. (b) The product shall conform to the latest applicable FSSAI standards and regulations prevailing at the tim e of supply. (c) FSSAI Licence number shall be indicated on the product packaging wherever applicable. (d) Each pack shall carry mandatory statutory declarations, including product name, net quantity, ingredie nts, batch/lot number, date of manufacture/packing, Best Before/Use By/Expiry date, manufacturer details, FSSAI licence number, MRP and storage instructions, as applicable. 4. PACKAGING (a) Each retail pack shall contain 200 g net quantity. (b) Packaging shall be food-grade, hygienic, properly sealed and suitable for transportation and storage. (c) Cheese Cube shall be suitably packed to prevent contamination, moisture ingress, physical damage an d deterioration. (d) Cheese Slice shall be suitably packed to maintain product integrity and prevent contamination, drying or deterioration. (e) Packs shall be free from leakage, swelling, damage, tampering and contamination. (f) Damaged, opened, leaking, tampered or otherwise defective packs shall not be accepted. 5. SHELF LIFE & STORAGE (a) The product shall have a minimum 75% of declared shelf life remaining at the time of delivery, subject to applicable procurement instructions. (b) Expired products shall not be supplied. (c) Product shall be stored and transported as per manufacturer's prescribed storage conditions and applic able food-safety requirements. (d) Where refrigeration/cold-chain is specified on the product label, the prescribed conditions shall be main tained during storage and transportation. 6. BIDDER ELIGIBILITY & DOCUMENTS

The bidder shall furnish/upload the following documents along with the bid: (a) Copy of valid FSSAI Licence/Registration. (b) Copy of PAN Card. (c) Copy of GSTIN/GST Registration Certificate. (d) Copy of Cancelled Cheque of the bidder's bank account. (e) Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by the concerned Bank. (f) Valid NCDFA Certificate. (g) Product technical specification/literature. (h) Product label/photograph clearly showing pack size. (i) Manufacturer details. (j) Undertaking regarding compliance with ATC and technical specifications. (k) Any other document specifically required in the GeM Bid. The product offered and supplied shall be genuine, original and legally marketed. 7. INSPECTION & ACCEPTANCE (a) Inspection shall be carried out by the consignee/authorised representative on receipt of stores. (b) Inspection shall include verification of quantity, pack size, physical condition, batch/lot, manufacturing/ expiry dates, shelf life, labelling and general quality. (c) The Buyer reserves the right to draw representative samples for testing through a Government/NABL-a ccredited/authorised laboratory, wherever considered necessary. (d) Acceptance at the time of receipt shall not absolve the supplier from responsibility for any latent defect /non-conformity subsequently detected. 8. REJECTION & REPLACEMENT The Buyer/Consignee shall have the right to reject the whole or part of the supply in case of: (a) Incorrect item or pack size. (b) Short quantity. (c) Damaged, leaking or tampered packs. (d) Expired/insufficient shelf-life product. (e) Improper/illegible labelling or invalid statutory details. (f) Mould, rancidity, abnormal odour/taste or contamination. (g) Failure of prescribed quality testing. (h) Any deviation from the stipulated specification. Rejected stores shall be removed and replaced by the supplier with fresh conforming material at his own cost and risk within the period stipulated by the Buyer. 9. QUANTITY & DELIVERY (a) Cheese Cube: 150 packs × 200 g = 30 Kg.

(b) Cheese Slice: 150 packs × 200 g = 30 Kg. (c) Total: 300 packs × 200 g = 60 Kg. (d) The supplier shall deliver the complete quantity at the consignee location specified in the GeM Contrac t. (e) Delivery shall be completed within the delivery period stipulated in the GeM Contract. (f) Short supply shall be made good by the supplier at no additional cost. 10. DELIVERY DOCUMENTS The supplier shall provide, as applicable: (a) Tax Invoice. (b) Delivery Challan. (c) Packing List. (d) Batch/Lot details. (e) Manufacturer details. (f) Quality/Test Certificate, wherever applicable. (g) Other documents required under the GeM Contract. 11. PRICE & PAYMENT (a) Price shall be as per GeM Bid/Contract and shall include all applicable costs as per GeM provisions, incl uding packaging, forwarding, transportation, loading/unloading, insurance and applicable taxes/duties. (b) Payment shall be made as per applicable GeM payment terms after satisfactory delivery, inspection an d acceptance. (c) Payment for rejected/short-supplied quantity shall be subject to satisfactory replacement/completion. 12. LIQUIDATED DAMAGES In case of delay in delivery, Liquidated Damages shall be applicable as per prevailing GeM Genera l Terms & Conditions and the GeM Contract. 13. PRODUCT SUBSTITUTION No substitution of product, manufacturer, brand or pack size shall be made during execution of the contrac t without prior approval of the Buyer and subject to applicable GeM provisions. 14. FOOD SAFETY & STATUTORY COMPLIANCE The supplier shall be responsible for ensuring that the products supplied are safe and fit for human consu mption and comply with applicable FSSAI requirements relating to manufacture, packaging, labelling, stora ge and transportation. 15. BIDDER'S UNDERTAKING “We certify that the Cheese Cube – 200 g and Cheese Slice – 200 g offered by us co nform to the technical specifications and Additional Terms & Conditions stipulated

in the GeM Bid. We undertake to supply 150 packs of 200 g each of Cheese Cube, c onstituting 30 Kg, and 150 packs of 200 g each of Cheese Slice, constituting 30 Kg , making a total quantity of 60 Kg. We further undertake that the products supplie d shall be genuine, fit for human consumption and compliant with applicable FSSAI requirements. Any rejected/non-conforming material shall be replaced by us at our own cost and risk as per the terms of the contract.” 16. GENERAL CONDITIONS (a) The bidder shall carefully examine all GeM Bid documents, specifications and ATC before submission of bid. (b) Submission of bid shall be deemed as acceptance of applicable terms and conditions. (c) The Buyer reserves the right to verify licences, documents and product details submitted by the bidder. (d) In case of conflict between this ATC and mandatory GeM provisions, the applicable GeM provisions shal l prevail. (e) Any deviation from the stipulated specification shall require prior approval of the competent authority a nd shall be subject to applicable GeM provisions.
